points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source builds in network-disabled cfd-bench with explicit externals; no CTests registered.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Input-driven case/output/restart CLI and documented launch scripts; no production case rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case, mesh, partition, physics, solver and output modules; fixed 2-D state remains.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal solver executable wrapper identified; external similarity investigation excluded under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Generic case-configured CGNS and BC paths; CGNS MIXED section unsupported.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Root-only preprocessing, METIS, owned/ghost exchange and reductions; rank-study exact binaries unbound.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity and finite checks present, with Newton–Krylov fallback; no independent memory stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Recorded examiner accepted eight outputs; isolated build succeeds, no registered CTests, no unsteady rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Documented scripts, original manifest and report; historic output git revision predates solver source.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
